metadata.title: Contact — Enzo Interiors
metadata.description: Tell us about the room. A free home survey across Leicester and Leicestershire, with drawings and an honest figure before anything is cut.

masthead.label: Contact
title: Tell us about
the room.
masthead.lede: Three answers is enough to start. We survey before we quote — so the first thing you get from us is a visit and a drawing, not a price plucked off a page.

routes.label: The docket
routes.datum: A reply the same working day

routes.label: By email
routes.datum: Read by the person who does the surveys

docket.label: Enquiry
docket.heading: Three answers and we can start.
docket.lede: Everything else is optional. Nothing here books anything, and nobody rings you unless you ask.
docket.note: We survey before we quote — so this starts a visit, not a price.

placeholders.name: Priya Shah
placeholders.message: The kitchen is about 4 × 3 m and we would like it done before Christmas.

hints.phone: Only if you would rather we rang.
hints.place: A town or a postcode is plenty.
hints.message: Rough sizes, a deadline, what the room is doing wrong now — whatever is useful.

errors.name: Tell us what to call you.
errors.emailMissing: We need an email address to reply to.
errors.emailInvalid: That address is missing something — check it over.
errors.room: Pick the room you have in mind.

docket.toast: Enquiry received — we will be in touch.

received.label: Received
received.heading: That is with us.
received.body: We read every enquiry ourselves — no call centre, no auto-responder that goes nowhere. You will hear from us the same working day, and we will offer two survey slots rather than asking you to guess at one.

when.label: Timing
when.heading: Write today. Finished when?
when.lede: From the day your message arrives, on our current book. The first fortnight is the same whatever the room — we come and measure, then you get drawings and a firm figure. Nothing is cut until you have signed those off, so the clock below only starts once you are happy.
when.keyBuild: Made in the workshop and fitted
when.keyNote: Indicative, on our current book. Your quotation carries the real dates.

ready.label: Before you write
ready.heading: You are readier than you think.
ready.lede: Almost everybody waits until they have had “a proper think” first, and the think never happens. Here is the honest list of what helps — and the much longer list of what people wait for and never needed.

helpful.note: A tape measure and thirty seconds. Wrong by 100mm is fine — we re-measure everything anyway.
Taken on your phone, from the doorway. It tells us more about the room than a paragraph does.
A range is plenty. It is what lets us tell you early if the room you have described does not fit it.

ready.unnecessaryLabel: Not needed, whatever you have been told
unnecessary: Knowing what you want it to look like
Having chosen a finish, a handle or a worktop
A floor plan, or anything drawn
Having decided you are definitely doing it
Having the money in place today
Knowing whether the wall is stud or masonry
ready.unnecessaryNote: Every one of those is our job, not yours. Working them out is what the survey and the drawings are for.
ready.closeLine: Or skip all of it and just talk to somebody.
